title: 2R planar arm
about: Two links turning about parallel vertical axes, 40 mm apart: the plane arm of every textbook.

title: SCARA arm
about: Turn, turn, slide, turn: two arms about vertical axes, a quill sliding up and down at the second arm's end, a tool turning on it.

title: 6R arm
about: Six turning joints, the industrial arm's chain: waist, shoulder, elbow and a three-axis wrist.

title: Cartesian gantry
about: Three slides square to each other — X, Y and Z — as on a 3-axis router or a 3D printer.

title: Pan-tilt camera head
about: Pan about the vertical, tilt about a horizontal axis on its side, and a camera (sensor) frame on the head.

title: Gear-coupled gripper
about: Two fingers on meshing gears of 20 teeth: the right one follows the left one, the other way round (1 : −1).

title: Four-bar linkage
about: A closed loop: turn the crank and the coupler and the rocker follow (one degree of freedom).

title: Gear-driven joint
about: A 20-tooth gear driving a 30-tooth one: the driven joint turns two thirds as far, the other way.
